approved: Underwater Cultural Heritage (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2018

The Underwater Cultural Heritage Bill 2018 updates the Historic Shipwrecks Act 1976, extending protection to human remains, sunken aircraft, and sites outside jurisdictional waters, while strengthening enforcement powers and public awareness. It covers approximately 7,500 historic shipwrecks and other underwater cultural heritage sites in Australian and Commonwealth waters.
